title: Figs. 8-9: Gemini M-4 In-Flight Phonocardiogram and M-6 Bone Demineralization
description: Two photographs from NASA document M-913-65-04. Fig. 8, "M-4 IN-FLIGHT PHONOCARDIOGRAM," shows a "PROTOTYPE PHONOCARDIOGRAM TRANSDUCER AND SIGNAL CONDITIONER" alongside a shirtless subject wearing chest sensors and wiring. Fig. 9 is a presentation board titled "GEMINI EXPERIMENT NO. M-6 BONE DEMINERALIZATION" listing purpose, equipment (standard X-ray), and procedure (pre and post flight X-ray), with an inset photo of a technician at an X-ray setup.
